WELCOME TO YOUR SOLAR FARM

Small acts. Brighter tomorrows.

Your field is empty and your starting investment is $300. Buy your first solar rack for $100, collect its earnings, and reinvest to grow. Each rack includes 24 panels and installation. Open Community (C) to turn your sunshine into homes, a greenhouse, and a shared workshop.

01Open the Shop, choose a plot, and buy a solar rack.
02Walk near its $ sign to collect earnings. Clean it when dusty.
03Upgrade your farm and connect your neighborhood.

WASD or arrows to move; click the ground to walk. Touch players can use the joystick. Daylight generates cash; nighttime is great for maintenance. Progress saves locally.

Your saved farm is ready to continue. To try the empty-field start, use Pause → Start a new farm.

The solar shop

SOLAR PANELS / STARTER RACK

Your first piece of sunshine

24 panels · $4 every 8 daylight seconds · 1 sun point per cycle. Installation included. Starts clean; collect cash by walking near the rack.

Hire your field crew

Workers walk to installed racks and work while you play—even at night. One-time hiring cost; no wages. Up to 6 workers.

Cleaners scrub dusty racks. Collectors bring rack earnings directly to your wallet. Crew work counts toward missions.

Cleaning tools

A cleaning cloth is included. Install a rack to unlock tool purchases.

Solar brush

Rack upgrades are bought in the field. Tier 2 yields $10 per cycle; Tier 3 yields $22 and stays clean longer.

Time pauses while you shop. Rack prices and earnings are game currency.

TAKE A BREATHER

Shift paused

WASD / arrows to move. Shift to sprint. Hold E to clean. U upgrades the nearest rack. T opens the solar shop; M toggles the field map; C opens community projects. Clean starter racks now last over five minutes of daylight before becoming fully dusty.

Finish cleanups less than 12 seconds apart for a streak. From your third cleanup, you earn a bonus. Watch for golden-hour sunbursts: double earnings!

Sunshine can do more than power a farm.

Sunlight becomes electricity

Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity that can help power homes, schools, and local businesses.

Cleaner energy, healthier communities

Replacing fossil-fuel electricity with solar can reduce greenhouse-gas emissions and air pollution.

Opportunity that grows locally

Solar projects support jobs in installation and maintenance. Community solar can help renters and people without suitable roofs access solar energy and potential bill savings.

Real-world benefits depend on the location and project. Your game earnings and sun points are fictional—not measurements of electricity or emissions avoided. Explore solar energy with the U.S. Department of Energy ↗

Your story doesn’t have to end here. Keep your farm, collect earnings, and take on repeatable goals—or begin again with an empty field and $300.
